subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should #101026 be split so Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening stays on a separate plugin API/security track, and which open hook-bypass PR should be canonical?
rationale: The remaining outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but `inbound_claim` changes claim authority and hook ordering for all channel traffic and cannot be safely resolved by automation alone.

options.title: Split outbound parity first
options.body: Fix Feishu/configured dispatcher `message_sending` coverage through the canonical hook-bypass PR path and keep normal-channel `inbound_claim` as a separate decision.

options.title: Use one umbrella hook PR
options.body: Fold Feishu parity and normal-channel claiming into a single broader design PR, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

options.title: Close after choosing a canonical duplicate
options.body: Close this issue only after a selected canonical issue or PR explicitly preserves the Feishu auto-reply/comment acceptance criteria and inbound-claim follow-up.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity first
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu/configured dispatcher `message_sending` coverage through the canonical hook-bypass PR path and keep normal-channel `inbound_claim` as a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook-hardening history and the live discussion point to this person as the best available owner for the plugin hook semantics decision.
